title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: rust/target build artifacts committed
description:
Commit d83cbc5 includes 3 files under `rust/target/debug/`:
- `rust/target/debug/deps/lichen_gateway-*.d` (Cargo dep file)
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/.../dep-graph.part.bin` (4.2 MB binary blob)
- `rust/target/debug/incremental/.../*.lock`

These are ephemeral build artifacts. They should never be committed. The root `.gitignore` or `rust/.gitignore` lacks a `target/` rule to prevent this. Should add `target/` to the appropriate `.gitignore` and remove these files from tracking.
